content.text: Skip to ArticleUnlimited Digital Access -Start Today for $1 - Sale Ends 5/3/26CloseDunkin’ is giving away free coffee for April Fools Day — yes, seriouslyUpdated: Apr. 01, 2026, 6:29 a.m.|Published: Mar. 31, 2026, 8:00 p.m.BURBANK, CALIFORNIA - MARCH 04: A view of a Dunkin' Donuts store on March 04, 2026 in Burbank, California. (Photo by Justin Sullivan/Getty Images)Getty ImagesBy Kelly Corbett | kcorbett@syracuse.comDunkin’ will be giving away one million free coffees on Wednesday, April 1, in honor of April Fools’ Day.Dunkin’ Rewards members can score a free hot coffee or iced coffee any size using the promo code STILLNOTAJOKE. No purchase necessary.Keep WatchingBiden puts Black man on the spot in cringe interaction during increasingly rare public appearance: ‘Doesn’t he look like Barack?'Biden puts Black man on the spot in cringe interaction during increasingly rare public appearance: ‘Doesn’t he look like Barack?'The promotion will be capped after one million redemptions, so members should enter it into the Dunkin’ app as soon as possible. Once claimed, the free coupon will then be added to one’s Dunkin’ Rewards account and can be used instantly. For those who want to save it, it will be valid until April 8.This marks the second consecutive year the Ben Affleck-approved chain has offered this April Fools’ Day perk. If you are not a Dunkin’ Rewards member, you can sign up for free here.Kelly CorbettKelly Corbett is a Trending News Reporter for syracuse.com | The Post-Standard. She covers a wide range of topics from celebrity and TV news to store closings and product recalls.
